# odinex_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Lists SSH keys, optionally filtered by a label selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_ssh_keys" "team" {
  with_selector = "team=ops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.

### Read-Only

- `ssh_keys` (List of Object) Matching SSH keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
